items.prompt: How did you meet the friends you see most often?
useful_language: we've known each other for years

items.prompt: How often do you manage to see your friends?
useful_language: not as often as I'd like
we message far more than we meet
we make a point of meeting up

items.prompt: What do you and your friends usually do when you get together?
useful_language: we go for a long walk
we take it in turns to cook

items.prompt: What kind of person do you find it easy to get on with?
useful_language: we don't have to agree on everything
a good sense of humour helps

items.prompt: How do you keep in touch with friends who live far away?
useful_language: we send each other voice notes
a long call every few weeks
we pick up where we left off

items.prompt: What do you remember about the friends you had at school?
useful_language: we got into all sorts of trouble
I still see one or two of them

items.prompt: Why do some people find it harder to make friends as they get older?
useful_language: there are fewer chances to meet people

items.prompt: What would you like to do with your friends that you haven't tried yet?
useful_language: something none of us has done before
we'd need to plan it properly
it would do us all good

items.prompt: How has the way people keep in touch with their friends changed?
useful_language: we hardly ever arrange things in advance

items.prompt: How is time spent with friends different from time spent with family?
useful_language: family know a different side of you
